title: Silver pipeline failed after schema rename
content:
## Incident
The customer Silver pipeline failed with a Spark unresolved-column exception.

## Investigation
Pipeline logs showed customer_status could not be resolved. Schema comparison showed that the upstream producer renamed customer_status to status during a deployment.

## Root Cause
An uncoordinated breaking upstream schema change caused the Silver transformation to reference a column that no longer existed.

## Resolution
The transformation mapping was updated, the affected partition was rerun, and downstream tables were validated before pipelines resumed.

## Lessons Learned
A schema compatibility check was added to detect breaking upstream changes before production processing.

title: Duplicate transactions after pipeline retry
content:
## Incident
Duplicate transactions appeared in the Gold table after an Airflow retry.

## Investigation
The original Spark execution had already written part of the batch before failing. Airflow retried the entire batch.

## Root Cause
The target write process was not idempotent, so replaying the batch inserted records that had already been committed.

## Resolution
The affected partition was quarantined, records were deduplicated using transaction_id, and the corrected batch was written using MERGE logic.

## Lessons Learned
Stable batch identifiers and idempotent MERGE operations were added to the pipeline.
